description: This file defines functions and types for constructing and marshaling array-like fields for logging in the Uber Zap logging library. It includes various constructors for slices of primitive types, objects, stringers, and time types, as well as internal types implementing zapcore.ArrayMarshaler for efficient serialization.

methods.name: Array
methods.description: Constructs a log field with a key and an ArrayMarshaler value.

methods.name: Bools
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of bools.

methods.name: ByteStrings
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of byte slices, UTF-8 encoded.

methods.name: Complex128s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of complex128 numbers.

methods.name: Complex64s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of complex64 numbers.

methods.name: Durations
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of time.Duration.

methods.name: Float64s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of float64.

methods.name: Float32s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of float32.

methods.name: Ints
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of int.

methods.name: Int64s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of int64.

methods.name: Int32s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of int32.

methods.name: Int16s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of int16.

methods.name: Int8s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of int8.

methods.name: Objects
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of objects implementing zapcore.ObjectMarshaler.

methods.name: ObjectMarshalerPtr
methods.description: Interface constraint for types implementing zapcore.ObjectMarshaler on a pointer receiver.

methods.name: ObjectValues
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of objects where pointers implement zapcore.ObjectMarshaler.

methods.name: Strings
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of strings.

methods.name: Stringers
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of objects implementing fmt.Stringer.

methods.name: Times
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of time.Time.

methods.name: Uints
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of uint.

methods.name: Uint64s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of uint64.

methods.name: Uint32s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of uint32.

methods.name: Uint16s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of uint16.

methods.name: Uint8s
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of uint8.

methods.name: Uintptrs
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of uintptr.

methods.name: Errors
methods.description: Creates a field with a slice of error.
